title: 1970地图所示启德铺面与海堤轮廓

source.title: Kowloon Peninsula, revised February 1970, HIST-HE08-1970
source.provider: Survey and Mapping Office, Lands Department, HKSAR Government
source.map_type: Scanned and georeferenced historical cartographic raster, NOT CAD or aeronautical chart
source.pixel_convention: GDAL corner origin; values below add 0.5 to raster pixel indices to sample pixel centres.

runway.coordinates_roles: 1970图上可辨铺面轮廓端；不是运营阈值/跑道宣布距离
runway.length_discrepancy_status: Unresolved. May reflect pavement/overrun versus declared length and/or cartographic generalization. No attribution to a specific cause is established.
runway.width_status: Approximately supported by these two cartographic transverse measurements; 61 m is not proved by this map as a 1970 aeronautical specification.

display_height_note: Illustrative scene-level elevation only, not a historical HKPD-to-EGM conversion. Parent may replace with consistent scene level.
land_polygon_notes: Visible peninsula coastline; NW closing edge is an artificial segmentation edge inside airport land.
Generalized airport ground/pavement envelope inferred from map; not a cadastral boundary or an exact apron outline.
Channel Rock: outline of the explicitly labelled 1970 map symbol, retained as a small island; not a surveyed rock perimeter. Height remains only illustrative.
water_cut_notes: Conservative narrow strip outside northeast runway shoreline; does not claim all eastern reclamation-in-progress was open water.
Conservative narrow strip outside southwest runway shoreline; leaves Kowloon Rock outside this cut.
Conservative strip outside shore of the northwest taxiway/link.

1970 map-confirmed open water beyond the old southeast seawall, upstream half. Channel Rock cartographic outline is excluded. Starts 65 m along axis beyond the measured SE paved end, after the mapped seawall.

1970 map-confirmed open water beyond the old southeast seawall, downstream half. Channel Rock cartographic outline is excluded. Ends 1150 m beyond the 1970 visible paved-outline end; lateral extent only covers the later runway reclamation vicinity.

uncertainty.small_scale_cartographic_linework: Original map scale 1:15,840; printing/scanning, line thickness and generalization dominate beyond raw pixels.
uncertainty.absolute_accuracy_status: No official RMS or positional accuracy for this raster was located. Do not advertise exact or centimetre-level coordinates.
uncertainty.working_render_tolerance_status: Conservative visualization allowance chosen for this task, not a statistically validated bound.
uncertainty.water_cut_status: Only conservative local strips are digitized. Reclamation-in-progress and a complete historical coast require further evidence.

control_checks.status: Qualitative same-map checks only, not a fitted control-point solution or RMS test.
control_checks.walled_city: The supplied/reference WGS84 point 22.332353,114.190417 transforms to E837663.161,N821478.400 and falls within the old Kowloon City area depicted in the raster. Image 1970-walled-city-pixels.png. This reference coordinate is not certified in this file.
control_checks.clock_tower: Reference WGS84 22.29361,114.16945 transforms to E835502.934,N817188.165, within the depicted old Tsim Sha Tsui station area. Map does not identify the clock tower separately well enough for a precise pixel residual. Image 1970-clocktower-pixels.png.
control_checks.conclusion: CRS orientation/location is consistent with airport, old walled city district, and old Tsim Sha Tsui station area; absolute georegistration accuracy remains unquantified.

endpoints.coordinates_role: NW midpoint of visible paved-outline end; NOT an operational threshold
SE midpoint of visible paved-outline end; NOT an operational threshold

attribution: Historical cartographic source: Survey and Mapping Office, Lands Department, HKSAR Government, via DATA.GOV.HK. Geometry traced and simplified for the fictional Train 88 scene.
era_label: 1970年地政署配準圖 · 延長前
accuracy_summary: 來源為1:15,840歷史配準圖；鋪面端不是航空入口。公布可用跑道2,529m，與圖上鋪面長度分列，入口仍待核實。

extension_water_evidence.classification: Water surrounding an explicitly mapped rock; not inferred from later airport construction.
extension_water_evidence.construction_phase_note: Later extension and reclaimed Channel Rock are absent in this 1970 map. This mask represents the source map epoch, not 1974/1975.

previous_marker_error.comparison: Against this map-derived 1970 axis, not an aviation survey.
